rooms.name: Deluxe King Room
rooms.Description: A contemporary room with a king bed, rainfall shower, and private balcony overlooking the palm gardens. Ideal for solo travelers and pairs.

rooms.name: Deluxe Twin Room
rooms.Description: Two twin beds in the same contemporary layout as the Deluxe King. Great for friends or colleagues sharing.

rooms.name: Seaview Balcony Room
rooms.Description: A larger room with a balcony facing the Arabian Sea or the pool. Fits up to three guests with a rollaway.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.Description: A two-room suite with a separate living area and sofa bed. Designed for families of up to four guests.

rooms.name: Presidential Suite
rooms.Description: The flagship suite with a jacuzzi, butler service, and sweeping corner views of the sea. Best for celebrations and VIP stays.
rooms.Note: Rollaway beds are chargeable at 1500 INR per night and available in Deluxe and Seaview rooms.

amenities.name: Lagoon Swimming Pool
amenities.Description: A large lagoon-style pool with a shallow kids' area, poolside loungers, and a pool bar serving drinks and light bites.

amenities.name: Wellness Spa
amenities.Description: Full-service spa offering Ayurvedic, deep-tissue, and aromatherapy massages, plus a steam room and sauna.

amenities.name: Fitness Centre
amenities.Description: Cardio machines, free weights, and yoga mats. Personal training available on request at 1200 INR per hour.

amenities.name: Beach Club
amenities.Description: Private stretch of Candolim beach with sun loungers, umbrellas, water-sports booking, and a beach bar.

amenities.name: Kids' Club
amenities.Description: Supervised indoor and outdoor play area with crafts, games, and movie screenings.

amenities.name: Business Centre
amenities.Description: Computers, printing, meeting room (1200 INR per hour), and videoconferencing.

amenities.name: Parking
amenities.Description: Free valet parking for all guests in the hotel driveway.

amenities.name: Wi-Fi
amenities.Description: High-speed Wi-Fi across all rooms, restaurants, and public areas. No password required for in-room connections.

amenities.name: Room Service
amenities.Fee: Included; 200 INR tray charge between midnight and 6 AM
amenities.Menu: Full in-room dining menu and all-day dining available.

amenities.name: Laundry & Dry Cleaning
amenities.Hours: Same-day if requested before 10:00 AM (collected by 9 PM)
amenities.Fee: Laundry from 250 INR; dry cleaning from 450 INR
amenities.Description: Pick-up and delivery to your room. Ironing also available.

amenities.name: Concierge
amenities.Services: Tours, excursions, restaurant bookings, tickets, and local recommendations.

amenities.name: Daily Housekeeping
amenities.Schedule: Twice daily (morning tidy and evening turn-down)
amenities.Description: Full turndown service with fresh linens, evening chocolates, and water.

dining.name: Coastal Spice
dining.Hours: Breakfast 7:00 - 10:30 AM, Lunch 12:30 - 3:00 PM, Dinner 7:00 - 11:00 PM
dining.Fee: Complimentary buffet breakfast included for guests
dining.Must Try: Prawn balchão, fish thali, and the tandoori platter
dining.Description: The main restaurant serving a lavish breakfast buffet with South Indian, North Indian, and continental counters. Open-air seating by the pool.

dining.name: Azure Terrace
dining.Fee: Average 2200 INR per person without beverages
dining.Must Try: Sushi platter, Thai green curry, wood-fired pizzas
dining.Description: Rooftop terrace with sea views and a sushi bar. Popular for sunset dinners and special occasions.

dining.name: Palm Bar
dining.Description: A swim-up-adjacent bar with live acoustic music on weekends and a relaxed lounge ambience.

dining.name: Poolside Cafe
dining.Description: Casual cafe by the lagoon pool serving snacks and cool drinks throughout the day.

dining.name: Breakfast Service
dining.Options: Buffet at Coastal Spice or in-room dining
dining.Note: Late risers can order continental breakfast in-room until 11:00 AM at no extra charge.

policies.Early Check In: Subject to availability, free of charge before 12 PM; 50% of one night after 12 PM
policies.Late Check Out: Subject to availability, 50% of one night for checkout until 6 PM; after 6 PM charged as an extra night
policies.Children Policy: Children under 6 stay free and eat free from the buffet; children 6-12 are charged 50% on meals
policies.Extra Bed: Rollaway at 1500 INR per night in Deluxe and Seaview rooms; not available in suites
policies.Pets Policy: Pets are not allowed inside the hotel; service animals are permitted with prior notice
policies.Smoking Policy: Smoking is not permitted in rooms, restaurants, or public areas; designated smoking zones are by the pool and on the beach
policies.Visitor Policy: Non-resident visitors must register at the front desk and are not allowed in rooms after 7:00 PM
policies.Cancellation Policy: Free cancellation until 72 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 72 hours or no-shows are charged one night. Peak-period bookings are non-refundable after 14 days before check-in.
policies.Deposit: A deposit of one night is required to confirm the booking
policies.Payment On Arrival: Full or partial balance can be settled by card, UPI, or cash on arrival
policies.Included In Rate: Breakfast, Wi-Fi, pool, beach club, fitness centre, parking, and daily housekeeping
policies.Excluded: Taxes (5% GST), 5% tourism tax, spa treatments, laundry, and all meals other than breakfast

services.name: Airport Transfer
services.Fee: 1500 INR one-way (per car, up to 3 guests)
services.How To Book: Via front desk or WhatsApp at least 24 hours in advance
services.Description: Private air-conditioned car transfer between Dabolim Airport (GOI) and the hotel.

services.name: Train Station Transfer
services.Description: Pick-up and drop from Thivim railway station.

services.name: Babysitting Service
services.How To Book: 4 hours in advance at the kids' club or front desk
services.Description: Trained nannies for children from 1 year old. Available 8 AM to 8 PM.

services.name: Excursion Desk
services.Tours: Dudhsagar Falls, Old Goa church tour, spice plantation, dolphin watching, and water sports (parasailing, jet skiing, banana boat).

services.name: Medical Assistance
services.Fee: Free on-call doctor; pharmacy at guest's cost
services.Description: 24/7 on-call doctor and tie-up with a hospital 10 minutes away. A first-aid kit is available at the front desk.

services.name: Safe Deposit
services.How To Book: In-room safe provided at no charge
services.Description: Every room has an in-room safe. The front desk also offers locker storage for valuables.

faqs.question: What time is check-in?
faqs.answer: Check-in is from 3:00 PM. If you arrive earlier, we will try to get you a room as soon as it is ready; before 12 PM it is free subject to availability.

faqs.question: What time is check-out?
faqs.answer: Check-out is at 11:00 AM. Late check-out is subject to availability (50% of one night until 6 PM, a full night after 6 PM).

faqs.question: Is breakfast included in the room rate?
faqs.answer: Yes. Breakfast is included in all room bookings as a buffet at Coastal Spice (7:00-10:30 AM) or via in-room continental breakfast until 11:00 AM.

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a swimming pool?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a lagoon-style swimming pool with a separate kids' area, open from 7:00 AM to 9:00 PM. It is complimentary for all guests.

faqs.question: Which room is suitable for three guests?
faqs.answer: The Seaview Balcony Room fits up to 3 guests (a rollaway can be added). For four guests, the Family Suite with a sofa bed is ideal.

faqs.question: What is the cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: Bookings can be cancelled free of charge up to 72 hours before check-in. Cancellations inside 72 hours or no-shows are charged one night. Peak-period stays are non-refundable after 14 days before check-in.

faqs.question: Do you provide airport pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Private airport transfers from Dabolim Airport cost 1500 INR per car and can be booked via the front desk or WhatsApp at least 24 hours ahead.

faqs.question: Is Wi-Fi free?
faqs.answer: Yes, high-speed Wi-Fi (100 Mbps) is complimentary throughout the property, including in all rooms.

faqs.question: Is parking available?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary valet parking is available for all guests, with capacity for 70 vehicles.

faqs.question: Does the hotel allow pets?
faqs.answer: Pets are not allowed inside the hotel. Service animals are permitted with prior notice at the front desk.

faqs.question: What languages do the staff speak?
faqs.answer: Our staff speaks English, Kannada, and Hindi. Front-desk staff can also arrange basic assistance in other languages on request.

faqs.question: Are children allowed, and is there a charge?
faqs.answer: Children under 6 stay and eat free from the buffet. Children aged 6-12 are charged 50% on meals. An extra bed costs 1500 INR per night in select room types.

faqs.question: Is there a restaurant in the hotel?
faqs.answer: Yes. We have Coastal Spice (Goan and Indian, all meals), Azure Terrace (Pan-Asian and Continental, dinner), the Palm Bar (evening drinks and tapas), and a Poolside Cafe (all day).

faqs.question: Does the hotel have a spa?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Wellness Spa offers Ayurvedic, deep-tissue, and aromatherapy massages from 2500 INR per session. Bookings are recommended 24 hours in advance.

faqs.question: Can I hold a business meeting here?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Business Centre has a meeting room for up to 10 people at 1200 INR per hour, with printing and videoconferencing available.

faqs.question: Do you have beach access?
faqs.answer: Yes, the hotel has a private stretch of Candolim beach via the Beach Club, open 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM with complimentary loungers and umbrellas.

faqs.question: What are the quiet hours?
faqs.answer: Quiet hours run from 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM across the property, so all guests can rest.

faqs.question: Is the hotel disabled accessible?
faqs.answer: Yes. All public areas, the Deluxe rooms, restaurants, and the Beach Club are wheelchair accessible. Accessible rooms are available on request.

faqs.question: Can I pay by UPI or card?
faqs.answer: Yes. We accept Visa, Mastercard, RuPay, Amex, UPI, and cash.

faqs.question: Do you offer laundry service?
faqs.answer: Yes, same-day laundry from 250 INR and dry cleaning from 450 INR, with collection before 10:00 AM and delivery by 9:00 PM.

safety.name: In-Room Digital Safe

safety.name: CCTV Surveillance
safety.Description: Round-the-clock CCTV coverage in public areas including lobbies, corridors, parking, and the pool deck.

safety.name: Fire Safety

seasonal.name: Peak Season
seasonal.Description: Winter in Goa with pleasant 22-30°C weather, the highest occupancy, and special festive dinners through Christmas and New Year.
seasonal.Tip: Book 4-6 weeks in advance for stays in January.

seasonal.name: Monsoon Season
seasonal.Description: Green landscapes and periodic rains; pool remains open and indoor experiences (spa, cooking classes) are popular.
seasonal.Tip: Best-value room rates of the year, offering up to 40% off.

seasonal.name: Festive Season
seasonal.Description: Diwali and the Goa International Jazz Festival nearby in April; themed dinners, live music, and cultural evenings.
seasonal.Tip: Ask the events desk about the current week's entertainment calendar.
